raw.author: CMEINDIA1
raw.text:
The Glucose Management Indicator (GMI) is a metric derived from Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) data that estimates a person’s laboratory-measured HbA1c. While GMI estimates A1C based on average glucose levels from 14+ days of sensor data, it is not identical to laboratory A1C, which measures blood sugar attached to red blood cells over 120 days. 

Key GMI & CGM Insights:

Purpose: GMI replaced "estimated A1C" (eA1C) to indicate current glucose control based on CGM data, rather than predicting the exact lab-tested result

GMI vs. A1C

 A lower GMI than lab A1C means the average CGM glucose is higher than predicted; a higher GMI than lab A1C suggests the average CGM glucose is lower than predicted.

Key Differences: 

GMI is based on daily glucose averages, whereas HbA1c is influenced by red blood cell lifespan.

Accuracy: 

While useful, GMI can differ from A1C due to rapid fluctuations, averaging 0.12–0.14 percentage points difference, though it can vary.

Usage: 
GMI is found on all standard CGM summary reports to guide diabetes management. 

GMI is generally considered more useful for evaluating recent glycemic trends (over 2 weeks) than laboratory HbA1c, which looks back over 3 months.

raw.author: KenDBerryMD
raw.text:
DOES YOUR BLOOD SUGAR CRASH MAKE YOU HUNGRY?

ZOE, Tim Spector's company, ran a study that put glucose monitors on 1,070 people and tracked thousands of meals. The people whose blood sugar dipped the most after eating got hungrier, ate their next meal about 24 minutes sooner, and ate about 312 more calories over the next 24 hours than the people with the smallest dips.

The links were modest, but they showed up. When a meal spikes your blood sugar and then drops it, you go looking for food.

That's one more reason I tell folks to cut the sugar and starch. It's a lot easier to stop eating when you're not riding that roller coaster.

raw.title: 大龄程序员，备考研究生学 AI
raw.content:
大专毕业到现在写了 10 多年代码了。
明年 12 月我要考计算机研究生。

我做跨境电商的。今年开始，我几乎不手写代码了。
需求丢进 AI ，代码出来，看一眼，就能上线了。几年后还需要我来看一眼吗？

AI 之前的软件工程，难如操作系统、浏览器、编译器，我一个都没写过。
但给我时间，我能写出来。至少我知道，它是怎么运转的。

AI 不一样
我不知道它是怎么实现的。我不知道一堆概率统计，怎么会长出“智能”的。

打不过就加入，于是我想加入一个实验室去学习。
既是担心未来工作，也是想把“什么是智能”这个问题弄明白

一年时间，高数线代、408 、英语、政治。有很多东西要学，时间不多了。
raw.content_rendered:
大专毕业到现在写了 10 多年代码了。 明年 12 月我要考计算机研究生。

我做跨境电商的。今年开始，我几乎不手写代码了。 需求丢进 AI ，代码出来，看一眼，就能上线了。几年后还需要我来看一眼吗？

AI 之前的软件工程，难如操作系统、浏览器、编译器，我一个都没写过。 但给我时间，我能写出来。至少我知道，它是怎么运转的。

AI 不一样 我不知道它是怎么实现的。我不知道一堆概率统计，怎么会长出“智能”的。

打不过就加入，于是我想加入一个实验室去学习。 既是担心未来工作，也是想把“什么是智能”这个问题弄明白

一年时间，高数线代、408 、英语、政治。有很多东西要学，时间不多了。
